operational_scope_distinction: B2 allows signed local proxy errors with at most one biased source. Under its trusted exact-peer/no-noise/at-most-one-bias assumptions, exactly consistent proxies imply zero local biases. The operational table additionally allows unexcluded common-source errors; the broader claim must not be attributed to the narrower two-world class.
